scopeProxy: Used for the 404 and 5xx pages Gately generates for this site (such as 502 when the backend is unreachable). With interception enabled below, errors returned by the backend are also replaced by this page.
scopeStatic: Used for error pages Gately generates for this site, such as 404 when a file is not found.
scopeOther: Used for the 404 and 5xx pages Gately generates for this site.
scopeDefault: Used for error pages generated by the default site, and for the 404 when no site matches the requested domain (also applies when the default site is disabled).
missingPage: The referenced custom page has been deleted. Visitors will see the default style; please choose again.
manageHelp: Upload an HTML file, paste code, or use a file on the server. Safety and usability are checked before saving.
staticOwn404: This site already has a 404 page {page}, which takes priority when a file is not found.
interceptHelp: Replace the specified status codes returned by the backend with the page above. The status code and response headers such as Cookie stay unchanged. Only requests that open a page in the browser are replaced; API, image, script and other resource requests keep the backend's original response.
codesHelp: Comma-separated; ranges and the 4xx / 5xx shorthands are supported. Only 400~599 is allowed.
codesEmpty: Enter the status codes to intercept
codesBad: "{code}" is invalid; only status codes or ranges between 400~599 are allowed
managerHelp: Pages in the library can be selected in each site's "Error pages" tab, and several sites can share the same page.
uploadHelp: .html or .htm, UTF-8 encoded, up to {size}. The content is filled in below and can be edited further.
htmlPlaceholder: Paste a complete HTML page, or choose a file with the button above
filePathHelp: Absolute path of an .html or .htm file on the server (a path inside the container for Docker). The file is checked for changes on every use; if it is unavailable, visitors see the default style.
placeholdersHelp: Placeholders in the page are replaced with the details of the current error and HTML-escaped. Hover to see their meaning.

ph.status: English status phrase, e.g. Bad Gateway
ph.title: Error title (in the visitor's language)

checkIdle: Checked automatically after you enter content or a path
checkOk: Check passed, the page is ready to use
checkWarn: Usable, but please note the following
removed: Will be removed on save (error pages do not run scripts, so these have no effect):
badExt: Only .html or .htm files can be chosen
notUtf8: The file is not UTF-8 encoded. Convert it to UTF-8 and try again
savedCleaned: Saved; {n} types of unsafe content were removed
batchHelp: Only the style is changed; each site's backend error interception settings stay as they are.
